lines.en: Luca, I wish I had joined this study group earlier. Last night we had been working for hours when the lights went out.
lines.pt: Luca, queria ter entrado neste grupo de estudo antes. Ontem à noite estávamos trabalhando havia horas quando a luz acabou.

lines.en: I heard about it. A classmate told me that the whole building had been without power since seven.
lines.pt: Fiquei sabendo. Uma colega me disse que o prédio inteiro estava sem energia desde as sete.

lines.en: Exactly. Someone asked whether we wanted to continue, and I said we should finish by candlelight!
lines.pt: Exato. Alguém perguntou se queríamos continuar, e eu disse que devíamos terminar à luz de velas!

lines.en: Typical Elsa! If you had gone home, you would have missed the best part of the story, right?
lines.pt: Típico da Elsa! Se você tivesse ido para casa, teria perdido a melhor parte da história, certo?

lines.en: Right. Our teacher, whose patience is legendary, walked in and asked why we were still there.
lines.pt: Certo. Nossa professora, cuja paciência é lendária, entrou e perguntou por que ainda estávamos lá.

lines.en: What did you tell her? I would have run away if she had caught me in the dark.
lines.pt: O que você disse a ela? Eu teria fugido se ela me pegasse no escuro.

lines.en: I explained that the project was being finished for Friday, and she said she had never seen such dedication.
lines.pt: Expliquei que o projeto estava sendo terminado para sexta, e ela disse que nunca tinha visto tanta dedicação.

lines.en: Then she must have been impressed. Did she say anything about the grade?
lines.pt: Então ela deve ter ficado impressionada. Ela disse algo sobre a nota?

lines.en: She told us that the results would be announced next week, and that we should rest properly tonight.
lines.pt: Ela nos disse que os resultados seriam divulgados semana que vem, e que devíamos descansar direito esta noite.

lines.en: Good advice. I have been sleeping badly all month, and I wish I had listened to my doctor earlier.
lines.pt: Bom conselho. Tenho dormido mal o mês inteiro e queria ter ouvido meu médico antes.

lines.en: Same here. Let’s promise to leave early next time, and to ask the caretaker for extra batteries!
lines.pt: Comigo também. Vamos prometer sair cedo da próxima vez e pedir ao zelador pilhas extras!

facts.label: Uma história de estudo
facts.sub: had been + -ing, wish I had, If I had…, whose, told us that, must have been.

facts.label: had been + -ing
facts.sub: Use had been + -ing para uma ação em andamento antes de outra no passado: We had been working for hours when the lights went out. Em português: “estávamos trabalhando havia horas”.

facts.label: wish I had, If I had
facts.sub: Use I wish I had + particípio para lamentar: I wish I had joined earlier. Use If + past perfect, would have + particípio: If you had gone home, you would have missed it.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “queria ter ido” e “ela me disse que o projeto já tinha sido entregue”.
compare.us: Em inglês: I wish I had gone; she told me that the project had been handed in. Combine past perfect, wish e discurso indireto.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Had been working describes an action in progress before another past action.
We say “I wish I would have joined”.
items.why: We say I wish I had joined.

items.s: Whose patience is legendary is a non-defining clause.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Had been working describes an action in progress before another past… → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I wish I would have joined”. → Falso (We say I wish I had joined.)
Whose patience is legendary is a non-defining clause. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A study group story · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cool night in Houston. Elsa climbs the stairs of the old building. A small study group meets on the third floor. Papers and cups cover the big table. Bia joins them a little later. Nobody notices how late it is.

“Bia, I wish I had joined this study group earlier. Last night we had been working for hours when the lights went out.” says Elsa. “I heard about it. A classmate told me that the whole building had been without power since seven.” says Bia. “Exactly. Someone asked whether we wanted to continue, and I said we should finish by candlelight!” says Elsa.
